title: Understanding Silhouette Score
text: The silhouette score measures how similar an object is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. A higher score indicates that the object is well matched to its own cluster and poorly matched to neighboring clusters.

title: Choosing the Right k
text: When selecting the number of clusters (k) in k-means clustering, we aim to maximize the average silhouette score. This helps ensure that the clusters are well-defined and distinct from each other.

hintAnswer: The clusters are $$well-defined$$ and distinct from each other.
